column1: # XMage Class#method <TAB> known_bug reason (gorge divergence, gorge function, CR, pin).
# xmageport -commit writes a FAILING generated scenario only when it is listed
# here; TestXMagePortScenarios then skips it and fails once it passes (stale).

column2: XP[cascade-grant-wascast-qualifier-not-admitted]: a layer-6 AddKeyword$ Cascade grant whose Affected$ is qualified by wasCastFromHand (Abaddon the Despoiler; Bloodbraid Marauder and Quandrix the Proof fail the same way, while Maelstrom Nexus and printed Cascade work) never gives the spell Cascade at cast time, so queueCascadeTriggers/cascadeInstances queue no trigger for the second Lightning Bolt (stack size 1, want 2; no Crimson Kobolds); real land taps change nothing (fork probe), moderate confidence on which function drops it, CR 702.85a, 613.1f, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[abilitytriggered-validdestination-unsupported]: Aboleth Spawn's T:Mode$ AbilityTriggered line carries ValidDestination$ Battlefield, which abilityTriggeredMatches deliberately fails closed on, so Ridgescale Tusker's ETB is never copied and the copy question is never asked (p0 creature counters 0, want 1), CR 603.2, 603.6a, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[count-crewed-valid-head-unsupported]: Adrestia's attack trigger is gated by CheckSVar$ X with X:Crewed$Valid Assassin, a Count head the evaluator (EvalCount) does not model, so after Nekrataal crews it the gate fails closed: no card is drawn and no Assassin type is added (lacks type Assassin, hand 0 want 1), CR 603.4, 702.122, verified at gorge 981b98963b. Isolating probe at gorge 981b98963b: the crew answer is honoured (Nekrataal, an Assassin, is tapped, Adrestia becomes a 4/3 Creature) yet the stack is empty after Adrestia attacks, so the trigger is never queued; hand 0, want 1 and no Assassin type, with no mana or boolean in the scenario.

XP[copy-x-etb-reads-copier-x]: triaged: XMage's expectation is wrong, gorge is right. The Altered Ego copy of Endless One enters 6/6 while XMage's test asserts 3/3 ("The X should not be copied"). CR 107.3m: an enters replacement that refers to X takes the X chosen for the spell that became the object, so the copied "enters with X +1/+1 counters" reads Altered Ego's X=3 and Altered Ego's own X=3 adds another three counters to the 0/0 (effClone/clonePT fold the copy exceptions; entryCounterGrants folds the entry counters). The row stays until the XMage test is corrected upstream. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[playercountremembered-youctrl-caster-relative]: both Batwing Brume halves resolve (the W/Fog half keeps p0 at 20 where it was paid and the B half is spent), but the B half "each player loses 1 life for each attacking creature they control" reads the SVar X:PlayerCountRemembered$Valid Creature.YouCtrl+attacking with YouCtrl bound to the CASTER, not the remembered player (evalCov3PlayerHead's Valid arm routes to evalCountBody): the caster has no attackers, so the attacking opponent loses 0 (want p1 19, observed 20). Gorge-side card/evaluator semantics. CR 608.2c + Oracle. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[playercountremembered-youctrl-caster-relative]: same remaining gorge cause as testOnlyBlackManaWasPaidCard: the W half runs (p0 stays at 20) and the B half is spent, but "each player loses 1 life for each attacking creature they control" counts Creature.YouCtrl+attacking relative to the caster (evalCov3PlayerHead -> evalCountBody), so the attacking opponent still loses 0 (want p1 19, observed 20). CR 608.2c + Oracle. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[ooze-destroyall-remembered-attached-no-match]: Corrosive Ooze's delayed DB$ DestroyAll ValidCards$ Remembered.Equipment+Attached never matches the Equipment attached to the remembered (departed) creature, so the Short Sword is not destroyed at end of combat (p1 graveyard Short Sword 0, want 1); effDestroyAll anchors Attached only for a Targeted. prefix and the departed creature's attachment needs last-known information (not isolated by event log), CR 701.8, 603.7, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[canenchantsource-predicate-missing]: Danitha's ETB ChangeType$ Aura.CanEnchantSource,Equipment.CanEnchantSource uses a predicate the filter vocabulary lacks, so UnknownPredicates fails closed (MatchesSpecCtx), no ask is posed and Nimbus Wings stays in the graveyard (P/T 4/4, want 5/6), CR 303.4f, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[canenchantsource-predicate-missing]: same cause: the CanEnchantSource predicate is absent from MatchesSpecCtx, so Gorgon Flail is never offered from the hand and is not attached (P/T 4/4, want 5/5), CR 301.5, 303.4f, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[dark-sphere-shield-not-consumed]: Dark Sphere's one-shot prevention shield (a command-zone Effect with a ReplaceDamage body whose ExileEffect SubAbility should remove it) halves BOTH double-strike hits from the chosen source, so the shield is not consumed after its first use (p0 life 18, want 17); the ChooseSource answer is consumed, so this is not choosesource-choice-not-selectable; the prevention-with-body path in replacement_damage.go, CR 615.1, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[playcopycard-cast-origin-not-exile]: Mizzix's Mastery casts the exiled card's copy through beginPlay's CopyCard$ path, which records the library holding zone (written for Cipher) as the cast's From, so Count$wasCastFromExile is false and Delayed Blast Fireball deals 2 instead of 5 (p1 life 18, want 15), CR 707.12, 601.2a, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[abilitycast-validsa-manaspent-term-unsupported]: Dynaheir's one-off AbilityCast trigger carries ValidSA$ SpellAbility.!ManaAbility+ManaSpent GE4, a term abilityCastConstraintHolds does not know for activations (only the spell half models ManaSpent), so it fails closed and Battlefield Butcher's {5} activation is never copied (p1 life 18, want 16), CR 603.7, 602.2, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[search-one-option-label-fallback]: both pieces now exist (numericPred reads Creature.totalPT_<CMP><n> and evalRefProperty reads TriggeredCard$CardSumPT), and effSearchLibrary does find the matching card: Wild Pair poses a choose whose sole option is Kind search, Label Silvercoat Lion. The scenario still fails because nothing answers that choose: the generated scenario carries only the optional-trigger yes, and the port's object-ref form p0:Silvercoat Lion resolves to the Silvercoat Lion already on the battlefield, not the library copy, so it is rejected; the fallback then takes the empty pick and no card is put onto the battlefield (p0 battlefield Silvercoat Lion 1, want 2). A bare label pick (Silvercoat Lion) is consumed and the scenario passes, matching XMage's auto-choice of the sole candidate (testWildPair comment). Interop gap in the port's one-option search answer/fallback, not the eligibility walk. CR 701.23a. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[clone-into-aura-no-copy-election]: no ETB copy election is posed at this pin: Estrid's Invocation resolves without a clone choice (transcript: the cast has no decision and the ported yes/template answers were dropped and never asked in the committed scenario), so it never becomes a copy of Feather of Flight and Grizzly Bears stays 2/2 (want 3/2). The remaining gap is on the offer side (faceETBChoice's clone arm and CloneETBOffered) rather than in the Aura entry: nonCastAuraEntrant and auraEntryChoice now handle a clone-template Aura entry, so the old election-posed-but-no-enchant-choice reason no longer describes the failure. CR 303.4f, 707.2, 707.9b. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[protectionall-validplayers-unmodelled]: Faith's Shield's fateful-hour DB$ ProtectionAll | ValidPlayers$ You gives the player no protection (effProtectionAll notes "a player cannot have protection"), so Lightning Bolt still hits p0 (life 2, want 5) although the Red choice is consumed, CR 702.16b, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[dig-attacking-defendingplayer-and-planeswalker]: Hans Eriksson's Dig (Attacking$ DefendingPlayer & Valid Planeswalker.ControlledBy DefendingPlayer) puts Grizzly Bears onto the battlefield tapped and it fights Hans but it does not enter attacking, so only Hans' 1 damage lands (p1 life 19, want 17); classifyAttackingEntryText/tokenAttackingPlayers degrade the entry (read from source, the degrade note is not in the transcript), CR 508.4, verified at gorge 981b98963b. Isolating probe at gorge 981b98963b (resolving the trigger right after the attack): Grizzly Bears arrives tapped with attacking=false in the snapshot, Hans stays the only attacker; no mana or choice in the scenario.

XP[choosesource-choice-not-selectable]: Harm's Way's ChooseSource ask is posed at resolution with card options that carry Obj but no Label (effChooseSource/sourceChoices), so the ported setChoice(playerB, "Lava Burst") is not offered and the fallback records the empty first option; with no chosen source the ReplaceSplitDamage shield's ValidSource$ Card.ChosenCardStrict never matches, so neither the damage to Aegis Turtle nor the damage to p0 is redirected (observed p0 20, p1 17, Aegis Turtle damage 2; want 18/19/4). ReplaceSplitDamage itself is implemented now (applyReplaceSplitDamageBody), so the old "unsupported card-script gap" reason is stale. CR 601.2c, 614.9. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[effect-lifereduced-replacement-unregistered]: Angel's Grace's SP$ Effect ReplacementEffects$ SelflessDamage (Event$ LifeReduced, ReplaceWith$ ReduceLoss) is never registered: effEffect only creates a bodied continuous-effect replacement for DamageDone/Destroy/Moved/CreateToken/AddCounter, and lifeReplacementCandidates' effect-created arm only scans bodyless Prevent$ True lines. The life floor is not applied; p0 loses to the combat damage and Bolt and the scenario's pass_to reports the game stopped (want p0 1). CR 614.1a / Angel's Grace Oracle. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[trig-mode-destroyed-unsupported]: same as testFirstTriggeredAbility -- Mode$ Destroyed is absent from triggerModeNames and checkFaceTriggers never queues it, so none of the destroyed noncreature permanents triggers (transcript: p1 graveyard Mountain/Swamp/Plains 0, want 1 each). CR 701.8 / 603.10a. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[mayplay-paylife-altcost-ignores-cantpaylife]: Bolas's Citadel's MayPlayAltManaCost$ PayLife<ConvertedManaCost> route still offers Lightning Bolt from the library top while Karn's Sylex' CantPayLife is on the battlefield: the may-play alt-cost price path (mayPlayAltCosts) never reads LifePaymentForbidden, which only the pay layer consults (cast offered=true, want false), CR 119.4b, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[cranial-extraction-zone-exiles-not-one-batch]: Cranial Extraction's graveyard, hand and library exiles are three chained effects (ChangeZoneAll then two ChangeZone) that each close their own zone batch (openZoneBatch/closeZoneBatch), so Laelia's "one or more cards exiled from your library and/or graveyard" trigger fires once per zone and she gets 2 counters where XMage's single search-and-exile gives 1 (P1P1 2, want 1), CR 603.2c, 701.23, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[cranial-extraction-zone-exiles-not-one-batch]: same cause with the opponent casting Cranial Extraction on the controller: the three zone exiles are separate batches, so Laelia triggers once per zone (P1P1 2, want 1), CR 603.2c, 701.23, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[permanent-effect-ltb-trigger-killed-by-own-source-leaving]: the DB$ Effect (Duration$ Permanent, source on the battlefield) registers LeavesPlay (ChangesZone, ValidCard$ Card.EffectSource) as a delayed trigger, but checkEventDelayedTriggers first calls delayedRegistrationLive, which drops a SourceBattlefield registration once its source is off the battlefield -- the very event it waits for kills it. Transcript: control is gained and Bolt kills Merieke, but Silvercoat Lion stays on the battlefield and the stack stays empty (p0 battlefield Lion 1, want 0; graveyard Lion 0, want 1). CR 603.10a / 603.6c. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[etb-repl-validcard-ignores-entering-statics]: the first Mimic's ETB counter replacement (ValidCard$ Creature.ChosenType+Other+YouCtrl) is matched by enteringObjectMatches against the second Mimic in its origin zone: entryBasisDiffers sees no entry-counter grant or entrant-sourced continuous effect, so enteringCounterBasisMatch falls back to the plain matcher, which cannot apply the entering Mimic's own chosen-type static. The second Mimic (chosen Dwarf) gets no +1/+1 counter (observed 2/1, want 3/2). CR 614.12. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[permeating-mass-clone-source-dead]: same cause: the damaged Dungrove Elder never becomes a copy of the Mass that died in the same damage step because effClone's Defined$ Self finds no source after it left the battlefield (p1 Permeating Mass count 0, want 1), CR 608.2h, 707.2, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[permeating-mass-clone-source-dead]: Permeating Mass's TrigCopy (DB$ Clone Defined$ Self) reads its source after the Mass died in the same combat-damage step, finds no battlefield object (knownDefinedTargets in effClone) and makes no copy; Hill Giant stays itself (Permeating Mass count 0, want 1) although a surviving Mass copies correctly, CR 608.2h, 707.2, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[choosesource-choice-not-selectable]: Refraction Trap's ChooseSource ask is posed but its card options carry Obj and no Label (effChooseSource/sourceChoices), so the ported setChoice(playerB, "Lightning Bolt") is not offered and the fallback records the empty first option. With no chosen source the ReDamage replacement's ValidSource$ Card.ChosenCardStrict never matches: the Bolt is not prevented (p1 17, want 20) and the ReplaceDamage/DealDamage chain never runs (Silvercoat Lion graveyard 0, want 1). The old "ValidTgts$ Any not posed at cast / unlinked replacement" reason is stale -- the target is asked at cast and the replacement primitive is implemented. CR 601.2c, 615.5. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[layer5-colors-battlefield-only]: the derived colour table records battlefield objects only: derivedColorTable's add closure returns for any object whose Zone is not ZBattlefield, so Painter's Servant's AddColor (AffectedZone$ All, chosen Black) never colours graveyard cards and Sanctifier en-Vec's ChangeZoneAll Card.Black,Card.Red skips Divination (observed p0 exile Divination 0, want 1). CR 611.3a, 613.1e (layer 5 applies to cards in all zones the effect names). verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[reveal-x-cost-unparsed]: Martyr of Sands' Reveal<X/Card.White> cost does not match the choiceCost pattern (Reveal<N/Spec> needs a literal digit count), so ParseCost degrades it to Unknown: no reveal is asked, X=0, the life gain is 0 and Serra Ascendant is a 1/1 that dies in the block (observed p0 life 21, want 30; Serra Ascendant battlefield 0, want 1). CR 107.3 / 601.2b (X announced in cost). Secondary translation issue: manaFromCostX treats the token "Reveal<...>" as hybrid R mana, giving activation mana "CR". verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[serra-paragon-rider-trigger-not-granted]: the graveyard cast works, but Serra Paragon's rider (an Animate granting the "when this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life" trigger to the permanent) never gives the permanent that trigger, so it just dies (p0 life 20, want 22; the card is not in exile; Memnite with real land taps behaves the same, moderate confidence on effAnimate/registerAnimateEffects), CR 613.1f, 603.10a, verified at gorge 981b98963b. Isolating probe at gorge 981b98963b: both fails reproduce with Naturalize paid by real Forest and Mox Pearl taps instead of seeded mana (life 20, want 22; Mox Pearl exile 0, want 1).

XP[setchoice-emitted-as-target]: Rootless Yew's library search does read Enigma Drake's CDA: effSearchLibrary/MatchesSpecCtx offers the */4 Enigma Drake (power = instants and sorceries in the graveyard), and a choose answer for p0:Enigma Drake is consumed with the hand expectation passing, so FilterDerivedPT is not the gap and the search is not limited to the shuffle ask. The real failure is translation-side: the ported XMage setChoice for the search is emitted as a target answer while gorge poses the pick as a choose, so the answer is unconsumed and dropped; with no choose answer the search falls back to an empty pick (observed p0 hand Enigma Drake 0, want 1). CR 604.3. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[choosesource-choice-not-selectable]: Shaman en-Kor's {1}{W} ability poses a ChooseSource ask whose card options carry Obj but no Label (effChooseSource/sourceChoices), so the ported setChoice(playerB, "Lightning Bolt") is not offered and the fallback records the empty first option; the SelflessDamage replacement's ValidSource$ Card.ChosenCardStrict never matches, so the Bolt kills the Lion while the Shaman survives (observed Lion battlefield 0, want 1; Shaman graveyard 0, want 1). The old ClearChosenCard$/effectChosenSnapshot claim is not the failing read at this pin: the choice is never bound. CR 614.9, 609.7. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[delayed-present-strictlyself-survives-blink]: Shirei's delayed return carries IsPresent$ Card.StrictlySelf, evaluated by delayedPresentGateHolds with the live-ObjID Self predicate, so a Shirei blinked by Momentary Blink (a new object) still counts as still on the battlefield and Muck Rats returns at the end step (Muck Rats 1, want 0), CR 400.7, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[exploited-predicate-missing]: DBPump's ConditionPresent$ Card.exploited uses a predicate the filter vocabulary lacks (there is no exploited case in the card-property matcher), so UnknownPredicates fails the condition closed and Haste is never granted. The +1/+1 counter lands: the exploit sacrifice answer (p0:Balduvian Bears) is consumed in the committed run and the counter is present, and the yes/no exploit election is absent from the committed scenario (the port dropped that XMage choice). Observed p0:Silumgar Scavenger has the counter but lacks Haste. CR 702.110a/b. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[abilitytriggered-validdestination-unsupported]: Strict Proctor's T:Mode$ AbilityTriggered line carries ValidDestination$ Battlefield, which abilityTriggeredMatches deliberately fails closed on, so the Primeval Bounty ETB trigger is never countered or taxed and the pay-{2} question is never asked (observed p0 life 23, want 20). CR 603.2 / 603.6a. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[choosecard-eachbasictype-unsupported]: ChooseCard ignores EachBasicType$ True (no such parameter exists): effChooseCard poses a single 0..1 "Land" choice (choiceBounds min=0 when not Mandatory) instead of one land per basic land type, so no lands are destroyed (observed Swamp/Forest/Island/Mountain/Plains graveyard 0, want 1 each). CR 608.2c. Note the XMage test is non-strict too. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.

XP[exiledwith-referent-not-recorded-graveyard-exile]: chapter I's exile from the graveyard (DB$ ChangeZone Hidden$ True) is not recorded as exiled with the Saga because moveZoneEvent/exileProvenanceNeeded only recognise the ExiledWithSource spelling, not the ExiledWith$CardManaCost / Defined$ ExiledWith its later chapters read, so chapter II adds 0 counters (Memnite P1P1 0, want 5) and chapter III returns nothing, CR 607.2a, verified at gorge 981b98963b. Isolating probe at gorge 981b98963b: the three fails reproduce with the Saga paid by real Forest taps instead of seeded mana (Memnite 0 P1P1, want 5; Gigantosaurus hand 0, want 1; exile 1, want 0).

XP[panharmonicon-skips-leaves-graveyard-trigger]: Thran Vigil's ChangesZoneAll Origin$ Graveyard trigger fires once under Panharmonicon because panharmoniconEntryTrigger classifies an Origin$-graveyard-only trigger as caused by the departure, though the reanimated creature entering the battlefield causes it (Ornithopter P1P1 1, want 2); gorge's exclusion is deliberate, so a gorge ticket may instead decide XMage's expectation differs, CR 603.2d, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[trig-mode-milledonce-unsupported]: same cause: Mode$ MilledOnce is not a registered trigger mode, so Whetstone's mill of both players creates no Horror tokens (Horror count 0, want 2), CR 701.17, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[lifestreams-copy-draws-x]: Twincast's copy of Lifestream's Blessing draws for the copy too (hand 2, want 1): the copy is not cast, so its X (the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast this spell) is 0, but the copy re-evaluates Count$LastStateBattlefieldWithFallback (copySpell/copy-state handling), CR 707.10, 601.2b, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[noabilities-reads-printed-face]: Ovinize strips Goblin Guide's abilities in layer 6, so Muraganda Petroglyphs should give +2/+2 (2/3), but NoAbilities reads the printed face only (noAbilitiesPermanent/FaceHasNoAbilities), still sees the printed haste/trigger and gives 0/1, CR 113.12, 613.1f, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[noabilities-skips-land-mana]: Vastwood Zendikon animates Forest to 6/4; its intrinsic '{T}: Add {G}' mana ability means it has an ability, so Petroglyphs must not apply, but FaceHasNoAbilities skips a land's mana ability and gives 8/6, CR 113.12, 613.1f, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[noabilities-ignores-granted-keyword]: Rancor grants Grizzly Bears trample in layer 6, so Petroglyphs must not apply (4/2), but FaceHasNoAbilities ignores granted keywords and gives 6/4; Dehydration's Runeclaw Bear (4/4) is right, CR 113.12, 613.1f, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[noabilities-ignores-cipher-grant]: Shadow Slice encoded on Grizzly Bears grants the cipher triggered ability, so Petroglyphs must not apply (2/2), but NoAbilities ignores the granted ability and gives 4/4, CR 113.12, 613.1f, 702.99, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[copy-spell-multi-target]: Beamsplitter's copy of a three-target Seeds of Strength puts five +1/+1 counters on the original target (7/7) and one on the chosen copy target (3/3), want 5/5 each; CopySpellAbility's per-target copy/new-target handling is wrong, CR 707.10, 707.10a, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[type-cycling-graveyard-draw]: Ash Barrens' basic landcycling and Astral Drift's cycling both resolve, but one cycled card never reaches the graveyard and the second draw is lost (hand 1/graveyard 1, want 2/2); TypeCycling:Basic / cycling resolution (Abandoned Sarcophagus only exiles Cycling$ False cards), CR 702.29a, 614.1a, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[unless-sacrifice-includes-source]: Oath of Lim-Dul's unless-discard chain sacrifices Oath itself (battlefield 0, want 1) and the stated Mountain pick is never consumed; SacValid$ Permanent.Other on the Repeat/Sacrifice unless cost does not honor 'other' (effects Sacrifice/unless), CR 701.21, 608.2c, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[cycling-draw-replacement-unmatched]: Unpredictable Cyclone replaces a nonland card's cycling draw with DigUntil/Play, but Desert Cerodon's cycling just draws (Goblin Piker battlefield 0, want 1); Event$ Draw ValidCause$ Activated.Cycling+nonLand replacement is not matched (replacement matching), CR 614.1a, 702.29, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[sharescolorwith-red-mismatch]: after Goblin Arsonist (red) enters, Spreading Plague should destroy the other red creature Goblin Archaeologist (battlefield 1, want 0); the Triggered.SharesColorWith filter matches no red creature (effects filter/Triggered.SharesColorWith), CR 105.2, 603.2, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[runadi-cast-replacement-missing]: Endless One cast with X=6 enters 6/6 instead of 8/8: Runadi's cast trigger replacement (X:Remembered$CardManaCost/Minus.4) adds no +1/+1 counters (effects replacement / EvalCount), CR 614.1c, 202.3, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[play-optional-never-casts]: Scholar's 'you may cast target instant/sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost' is chosen ('Play Divination') but Divination is never cast or exiled (exile 0, hand 0); DB$ Play Optional/WithoutManaCost$ resolves without casting (effects.Play), CR 601.2f, 118.9, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[voyage-decline-return-missing]: after the second land's 'No' to a voyage counter, Cosima should return with X +1/+1 counters and draw X; gorge keeps it exiled with a VOYAGE counter (P1P1 0, P/T 2/4, hand 1, want 1 counter/3/5/2); DBReturn's ConditionCheckSVar$ Y / PutCounter Optional path never returns it, CR 603.2, 608.2c, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

XP[allcreaturetypes-library-filter]: Magda's 'search for an artifact or Dragon card' offers only Sol Ring; Pinnacle Monk (a creature card in the library) should be every creature type including Dragon under Maskwood Nexus's AddAllCreatureTypes$ True AffectedZone$ All, but the ChangeZone filter does not apply the type grant outside the battlefield (effects filter/ChangeZone), CR 613.1d, 205.3, verified at gorge 981b98963b.
